title: Fleet energy
subtitle: Estimated electricity use of your Sparks from GPU and CPU power telemetry. Not wall-metered.

resetNote: Power keeps being recorded from now on, and Monthly history is kept. This can't be undone.
membershipBody: Sparks were added or removed since energy accounting started, so totals would no longer be comparable. Restart sparkDash to start a new accounting scope. Previous hourly history is withheld until then.
warmingBody: No complete energy interval has been recorded yet. Data appears here once every node has reported fresh power telemetry for a little while.
stale: Could not refresh just now; showing the last data received.
estimatedBody: Figures are integrated from GPU and CPU power readings and leave out power-supply losses and other components, so the wall draw is somewhat higher.

tiles.noCompare: No earlier period to compare yet
tiles.setPrice: Set an electricity price in Settings
tiles.noTokenData: No token data in this range

noDataBody: Try a longer range, or check that the Sparks are reporting power telemetry.

effPanel.title: Efficiency
effPanel.sub: Wh per 1,000 generated tokens, per {{unit}}. Lower is better; idle time counts.

nodes.sub: Each node is measured only while it reports, so coverage differs per node.

nodes.costNeedsPrice: Cost needs an electricity price; set one in Settings.

insights.title: Insights
insights.empty: Insights appear once there is enough recorded data in this range.
insights.topNode: {{node}} uses the most energy: {{kwh}} kWh, {{share}}% of the fleet total.
insights.bestDay: {{day}} was the highest-use day with {{kwh}} kWh.
insights.bestDayAbove: That is {{percent}}% above the {{average}} kWh average of well-covered days.
insights.nightLower: Overnight (22:00 to 06:00 local) the fleet averaged {{night}}, {{percent}}% lower than the {{day}} daytime average.
insights.nightHigher: Overnight (22:00 to 06:00 local) the fleet averaged {{night}}, {{percent}}% higher than the {{day}} daytime average.
insights.nightSteady: Draw is steady around the clock: {{night}} overnight versus {{day}} during the day.
insights.weeklyCost: At {{rate}} per kWh, this pace would cost about {{amount}} per week.
insights.weeklyCostNote: This is a rough extrapolation from the data recorded so far, not a forecast.
insights.tokensPerKwh: The fleet generated about {{tokens}} output tokens per kWh ({{wh}} Wh per 1,000 tokens), counting idle time in the same hours.

about.title: About this data
about.estimatedBody: Energy is power telemetry (GPU + CPU) integrated over time, not a wall meter reading.
about.gapsBody: Hours with no telemetry are left out, never filled in. Coverage is the share of time every node reported fresh data; per-node coverage is in the table.
about.efficiencyBody: only counts tokens and energy from time when all nodes were reporting.
about.retentionBody: Hourly history is kept for 31 days. Longer ranges show what exists so far.
about.localTimeBody: Hours and days follow the time zone in Settings, or this browser's by default ({{zone}}). Hourly rows are stored in UTC.
about.membershipBody: Adding or removing a Spark starts a new accounting scope after a sparkDash restart.

monthly.title: Monthly history
monthly.subtitle: Totals per UTC month, kept permanently. They survive resets, restarts and changes to the fleet. Months are UTC, so they will not match a local-time electricity bill.
monthly.empty: Nothing archived yet. Each finished minute is added to its month once the Sparks have been reporting for a little while.
monthly.caption: Energy by node for {{month}}
monthly.footNote: Only the Sparks that reported in {{month}} are listed. Coverage is the share of the month each one was measured{{soFar}}. Estimated, not metered.
